subject.title: fix(skills): coding-agent completion works with SecretRef auth

question: Should the bundled coding-agent skill standardize parent-owned terminal delivery as its durable boundary for all external coding workers, rather than require a scoped worker-side notification capability?
rationale: The branch selects a persistent security and delivery ownership model for a bundled workflow; the linked issue requests a fix but does not establish that this particular cross-worker contract is the maintained product direction.

options.title: Adopt parent-owned delivery
options.body: Confirm the parent retains notification routing and credentials, contingent on live proof of one terminal notification for successful and failing real workers.

options.title: Design a scoped worker capability
options.body: Keep worker execution isolated but define a deliberately constrained notification capability if maintainers need workers to notify independently.

recommendation.title: Adopt parent-owned delivery
recommendation.body: Confirm the parent retains notification routing and credentials, contingent on live proof of one terminal notification for successful and failing real workers.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related merged SecretRef work is the closest available history signal for preserving strict credential resolution while improving behavior around unavailable SecretRefs.
